🎥🎬: Twisted Metal (2023)

In a dangerous post-apocalyptic wasteland, John Doe, a fast-talking delivery driver, is offered a chance at a better life if he can successfully deliver a mysterious package across a lawless landscape filled with ruthless gangs, deadly vehicles, and unpredictable killers.

Along the way, John encounters Quiet, a fierce and resourceful outlaw, and crosses paths with Sweet Tooth, a terrifying masked killer who drives a heavily armed ice cream truck. With danger lurking around every corner, survival depends on speed, strategy, and knowing when to run for your life.

Packed with explosive car chases, brutal battles, outrageous characters, and dark comedy, Twisted Metal turns the open road into a deadly game where every driver has a weapon and nobody plays by the rules.

Twisted Metal is now streaming on Peacock. #SonyPicsPartner
